title: Organization (logical)
identity_concept: Governed organization identifier, independent of any natural name or physical key.
cardinality: One organization to many affiliation cases across seasons.
temporal_posture: Continuity preserved across seasons; identity is durable.
correction_posture: Corrections applied by supersession preserving prior identity history.
scope_posture: Scoped to its jurisdiction and PTSO context.

title: Club (logical)
identity_concept: Governed organization identifier specialized as a club.
cardinality: Many clubs to one PTSO.
correction_posture: Supersession preserves recognition history.

title: PTSO or Member Association (logical)
identity_concept: Governed organization identifier specialized as a jurisdictional association.
cardinality: One association to many clubs.
correction_posture: Supersession preserves history.

title: Person
identity_concept: Governed person identifier; a person is never equal to an account or a membership.
cardinality: One person to many accounts, memberships, and authorities.
correction_posture: Identity resolution by governed supersession, never silent merge.
scope_posture: Person governance is House-scoped; authentication is external.

title: Authenticated Identity (account)
identity_concept: External authentication subject reference; not a person and not an authority.
cardinality: Many accounts to one person.
correction_posture: Rebinding is a governed operation with preserved history.
scope_posture: Authentication authority is external; binding authority is House.

title: Organization Membership
identity_concept: Membership fact linking a person to an organization; not an authority.
cardinality: Many memberships per person and per organization.
correction_posture: Governed correction preserves membership history.

title: Representative Authority
identity_concept: Delegation fact; distinct from membership and from role labels.
cardinality: Many authorities per person and per organization.
correction_posture: Governed correction preserves delegation history.
scope_posture: Scoped to an organization and a set of governed actions.

title: Reviewer Assignment
identity_concept: Assignment fact; distinct from a reviewer role.
cardinality: One case to one active reviewer assignment at a time.
correction_posture: Reassignment is governed and preserves prior assignment.
scope_posture: Scoped to a case and jurisdiction.

title: Jurisdiction (logical)
identity_concept: Governed jurisdiction identifier.
cardinality: One jurisdiction to many organizations and cases.
correction_posture: Supersession preserves prior jurisdiction context.

title: Season (logical)
identity_concept: Governed season identifier with unique boundaries.
cardinality: One season to many affiliation cases.
temporal_posture: Seasons do not overlap for a jurisdiction.
correction_posture: Season boundary corrections are governed.
scope_posture: Scoped by jurisdiction where variant seasons apply.

title: Policy Version
identity_concept: Policy identifier plus governed version.
cardinality: One policy to many versions; one version to many requirement versions.
temporal_posture: Effective and superseded times preserved; prior versions never mutated.
correction_posture: New versions supersede; history preserved.

title: Requirement Version
identity_concept: Requirement identifier plus governed version, bound to a policy version.
cardinality: Many requirement versions to one policy version.
correction_posture: Supersession preserves prior requirement text.

title: Affiliation Case
identity_concept: Governed case identifier scoped to organization and season.
lifecycle: draft, submitted, under_review, approved, active, suspended, revoked, closed, archived
cardinality: One case per organization per season.
correction_posture: State changes only through governed transitions; corrections by supersession.
scope_posture: Scoped to organization, jurisdiction, and season.

title: Pathway
identity_concept: Governed pathway identifier applicable to a case.
cardinality: One case to one applicable pathway.
temporal_posture: Pathway applicability resolved at case time.
correction_posture: Pathway change is a governed correction.

title: Response
identity_concept: Governed response identifier bound to a case and requirement version.
cardinality: One response per requirement version per case.
correction_posture: Correction by governed supersession.

title: Evidence Metadata
identity_concept: Governed evidence-metadata identifier referencing an external binary.
cardinality: Many evidence items to one response.
correction_posture: Withdrawal and replacement are governed operations.

title: Decision Record
identity_concept: Governed decision-record identifier bound to a case.
cardinality: One active decision per case review outcome.
temporal_posture: Decision records are immutable and preserved.
correction_posture: Superseding decisions preserve prior decisions.

title: Fee Obligation
identity_concept: Governed fee-obligation identifier scoped to a case and season.
cardinality: One or more obligations per case.
correction_posture: Governed correction preserves prior obligation state.

title: Payment Acknowledgement
identity_concept: External payment reference; not an accounting confirmation.
cardinality: Many acknowledgements to one obligation.
correction_posture: Corrections sourced from the external system are governed on import.

title: Accounting Confirmation
identity_concept: External accounting reference distinct from payment acknowledgement.
cardinality: Many confirmations to one obligation.
correction_posture: Governed on import.

title: Reconciliation Record
identity_concept: Governed reconciliation identifier.
cardinality: One reconciliation per obligation resolution.
correction_posture: Exceptions resolved by governed correction.

title: Activation Record
identity_concept: Governed activation identifier bound to a case.
cardinality: One active activation per case.
correction_posture: Suspension and revocation are governed transitions.

title: Affiliation Case State
identity_concept: Case identifier plus governed state; state is a record, not a mutable field.
cardinality: One current-state record per case, with preserved transition history.
temporal_posture: Effective and recorded times preserved for each transition.
correction_posture: State is never silently mutated; corrections are governed transitions.

title: Submission Snapshot
identity_concept: Governed snapshot identifier bound to a case and submission time.
cardinality: One snapshot per submission event.
temporal_posture: Captures state as known at submission time.
correction_posture: Not correctable; superseded by a later snapshot.

title: Audit Event
identity_concept: Governed audit-event identifier; append-only and never mutated.
cardinality: Many audit events per governed entity.
correction_posture: Not correctable; corrections are new appended events.

title: Lineage Record
identity_concept: Governed lineage identifier linking a derived product to its source.
cardinality: Many lineage records per derived product.
correction_posture: New lineage supersedes prior for the same refresh.

title: Administrative Correction
identity_concept: Governed correction identifier referencing the superseded fact.
cardinality: Many corrections per corrected entity.
temporal_posture: Correction time and effective time preserved.
correction_posture: Requires named correction authority.

title: Governed Identifier
identity_concept: Value has no identity of its own; it identifies an owning entity.
